memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent with ADLs, walks 30 min daily, uses cane occasionally for knee pain.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal) – negative screen.
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds – normal.
medicines: 6 regular – clobetasol 0.05% cream BD topically; calcipotriol ointment OD topically; methotrexate 7.5 mg once weekly; folic acid 5 mg OD; allopurinol 100 mg OD; febuxostat 40 mg OD. Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports good spirits, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Daughter, Priya – primary support.
goal: "Stay active and keep my skin clear so I can enjoy time with my grandchildren."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: LFT: ALT 45 U/L (≤40), AST 38 U/L (≤40), ALP 80 U/L (30‑120), bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (0.2‑1.2). CBC: Hb 13.8 g/dL (13‑17), WBC 6.2 ×10⁹/L (4‑10), platelets 210 ×10⁹/L (150‑400). Creatinine 1.0 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2). Uric acid 8.5 mg/dL (≤7.0).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: "I’ve had a painful gout flare in my left big toe for two days, swollen and red. I’m taking extra colchicine but it’s not helping much."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: colchicine 0.5 mg – take BD for 3 days during flare – then stop

mood: Better, denies depression.
carers: Daughter, Priya – primary support.
